name: Immofacile
positioning: A French agency package sold module by module, so a small agency buys only the trade it practises.
description: Immofacile provides French real estate professionals with transaction software, rental management and syndic modules, portal publishing, agency websites and document management, packaged so an agency subscribes only to the activities it holds.
real_estate_use: Small French agencies rarely practise all three regulated activities, and paying for a full administration suite to run transaction alone is a common source of overspend. Modular pricing is the practical argument here, with the option to add gérance later without migrating the client and property records.
features: Modular transaction, rental and syndic activities

use_cases.job: Subscribe only to the regulated activities the agency actually practises
Add rental management later without migrating existing records
